item.title: California passes toughest wildfire rules in the U.S. for home landscaping
item.description: California has adopted the toughest new rules in the country that require homeowners to manage the plants around their houses. Fire experts say it helps protect houses from burning, but public pushback has been strong.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: On his 19th birthday, a vigil is planned for Mississippi teen Nolan Wells
item.description: There's a vigil Wednesday night in Mississippi to mark the birthday of Nolan Wells. The teen who was found dead after being left on a island would have been 19 years old.

item.title: In new filings, Kennedy Center says it won't try to put Trump's name on facade until Sept. 8
item.description: Lawyers for Rep. Joyce Beatty asked a judge to rule speedily on the complex's renovation and entrance tarp. The National Symphony Orchestra also announced its new season, away from the Kennedy Center.

item.title: Why does the U.S. military seem stymied in the war with Iran?
item.description: Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn says while the U.S. military is facing long-range missile shortages, prolonged deployments and vacated regional bases, Iran is building cheaper weapons quickly.

item.title: 15 states have laws that allow corporal punishment in schools. Here's where, and why
item.description: There is broad consensus among psychologists that corporal punishment can be harmful to children, but the U.S. has no federal laws banning it in public schools.
item.content:encoded: There is broad consensus among psychologists that corporal punishment can be harmful to children, but the U.S. has no federal laws banning it in public schools.

item.title: U.S. delays 50% tariff on Canadian imports after reaching deal
item.description: The U.S. has delayed imposing an additional 50% tariff on about $20 billion in imports from Canada after President Trump said the two countries reached a last-minute deal.

item.title: Trump says U.S. and Canada reached deal to delay 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports
item.description: President Trump said he was delaying the 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports after the two countries reached a last-minute deal less than two hours before the sanctions were to go into effect.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: New efforts to establish a more elaborate "smart wall" along parts of the U.S.-Mexico border are spawning protests in Arizona.

item.title: In Portland, this soap box derby combines downhill speed with extreme pageantry
item.description: Soap box derbies send motorless cars down a steep incline. At one event, contestants make their cars look like cartoon characters, subway cars, food, and giant animals (among other outlandish shapes).
